notes: «حَدَّثَنِی مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بِإِسْنَادِهِ» opens with a back reference («بإسناده») to an earlier isnad; that earlier isnad is not in this text

«معلى بن خنيس» appears twice: in the text order, once as the first link and once as the man who «قال سمعت أبا عبد الله»; both are written as they stand, and the reading does not merge them (rule 9); the «قال حدثني محمد بن يحيى» line is read as continuing the chain as written, uncertain whether it starts a new isnad
the Imam is named in Mu'alla's words («سمعت أبا عبد الله»): last link, imam_in_text (owner ruling 2)
